# factually.co

> > A curated collection of entertainment resources spanning TV listings (TV Guide), viral internet culture (Know Your Meme), and science journalism (Scientific American).

This site aggregates content from multiple entertainment and media properties, providing TV schedules, streaming guides, meme documentation, and scientific content. Key platforms covered include Netflix, TikTok, and traditional broadcast television.

## Key Topics

- TV Guide
- Know Your Meme
- Scientific American
- TikTok trends
- Netflix streaming
- viral memes
- TV schedules
- entertainment news
- local TV listings
- exploitable memes
- celebrity news
- streaming services
- viral videos
- image macros

## TV Listings & Streaming Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage: streaming recommendations, TV reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings finder by provider for shows, movies, programs
- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix catalog browser with filters for movies, TV shows, genres, years
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, soccer, college basketball

## Viral Memes & Internet Culture

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl lying over cat, viral on TikTok/Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase
- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean? The Viral '90s Hood... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Explainer on Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Viral meme explainer about Nasra Ahmed's ICE detention speech in Minneapolis

## Scientific American Content

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): Documentary film grant ($80K) for endangered species conservation stories
- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm. | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Subscription pricing: digital ($30/yr) and print+digital ($60/yr) plans
